Seminar Title:

High-Order Compact Scheme for Solving the Time-Fractional Black–Scholes Equation with Stability Analysis

Seminar Type:

Departmental Seminar

Department:

Mathematics

Speaker Name:

Santoshi Tarei

Speaker Type:

Date and Time:

15 Jul 2026 04:00 PM

Contact:

Dr. Ankur Kanaujiya

Abstract:

A high-order compact finite difference scheme on a uniform mesh is proposed for solving the time fractional Black-Scholes partial differential equation governing European-type options. The time fractional derivative is discretized using the L2 -1σ formula, resulting in an overall accuracy of O((∆t)2 +(∆x)4). A rigorous stability and convergence analysis of the proposed scheme is presented. Numerical experiments validate the theoretical results and demonstrate the superior accuracy and computational efficiency of the proposed method compared with existing schemes
